conclusions: All four lane-0 fourth-token receptions precede the later 12K request's client dispatch and admission; that request cannot cause the already-observed first divergence.
The fourth-token step has one scheduled D request and three pending initialization P128 requests (384 tokens), not a four-request decode batch.
The lane-0 request was initially admitted alone at P128; the other three initial P128 requests were coadmitted afterwards. Initial P state and concurrent P384 remain possible causes.
No logits, per-layer state or physical device timing was observed; equal token prefixes do not imply equal KV/GDN state.
limits: SSE time is client byte-chunk completion, not device token-computation time. Reception before later admission is a strong exclusion; reception after admission alone would not prove GPU execution after it.
Fourth-token model step is inferred from native synchronous, non-speculative one-token scheduling and computed_before=prompt_length+2, not a device timestamp or explicit sampled-token trace.
Trace decode count is logical model batch size; actual ACL graph entry/replay requires separate worker/device evidence.
This is causal exclusion of the later 12K request, not attribution to fusion, precision, communication or KV corruption.
